title: Same word, every time
prompt: A message encrypted with a repeating keyword (Vigenère). The sender left a clue about the key. The Cipher Quest tools can help.
hint.1: The key is a word; each letter of it is a different Caesar shift.
hint.2: The company in this story is Halcyon.
hint.3: Decrypt with key HALCYON; punctuation is not encrypted and does not use up key letters.
walkthrough: Decrypt the text with the key HALCYON. The result is the flag.
